package.name: robot_feasibility_test
package.description: Robot force-control feasibility test platform. A headless test engine (with an optional web dashboard) that characterises a robot's forward-position-controller (FPC) behaviour before deploying host-side admittance / Cartesian force control on top of it. It reads the robot's joints from the URDF (/robot_description), lets the operator pick joints to test, then runs an automatic battery per joint -- tracking (smooth / stair / smoothed), step response, structural resonance and a frequency sweep -- driving the arm's ForwardCommandController and recording the actual joint motion (and the wrist wrench, if available). From the measured metrics it produces a force-control readiness scorecard (Suitable / Marginal / Unsuitable) with a predicted stable admittance bandwidth.
